Groups are sub-sets of the entire list. They may be used to separate people into different categories, such as "Museum Supporters" or "Board Members" or "Audit Committee" People may belong to as many of these Groups as is appropriate.

You may also separate contacts into mutually exclusive groupings using the Custom Field (by clicking on Edit contact name). Typically this makes sense when contacts in the list are being assigned exclusively to one or another category ("male" or "female").

To send out questionnaires to select a meeting date, go to Create new questionnaire under Get-togethers. Then go to Compose & send Emailunder the Communicator heading on the right to send out the questionnaire to your group. To view people's responses, click on View Responses to Questionnaire under Get-togethers. You may only have one Get-together questionnaire out at a time, as creating a new questionnaire deletes the old one.
